description: An integer overflow flaw in the X.Org Server's XRes QueryClientIds handling affects 32-bit servers and can result in reads past the request buffer, potentially leading to server crashes or unintended memory access.
A bounds-checking flaw in the X.Org Server's XvShmPutImage handling can result in an out-of-bounds read or write, potentially leading to server crashes or memory corruption.
An integer overflow flaw in the X.Org Server's XRes QueryResourceBytes swap path affects 32-bit servers and can result in memory corruption or server crashes.
A flaw in the X.Org Server's XvQueryImageAttributes reply handling can result in clients receiving an incorrect data size value, potentially leading to improper buffer allocation or usage.
An integer overflow flaw in the X.Org Server's glamor Xv image size computation can result in out-of-bounds reads, potentially leading to server crashes or unintended memory access.
Binary-patch size validation can be bypassed because it checks the encoded input rather than the inflated result, potentially causing an out-of-bounds read and crash.
A flaw in the X.Org Server's XvPutImage length validation can allow requests with missing image data to be processed, potentially leading to server crashes or misbehavior.
A flaw in the X.Org Server's XTestFakeInput handling can result in a stack out-of-bounds write, potentially leading to server crashes or stack memory corruption.
A flaw in the X.Org Server's handling of EDID Display-Range descriptors can result in an out-of-bounds write, potentially leading to server crashes or memory corruption.
Recursive clones can lead to remote code execution through unsafe handling of submodule-related repository metadata.
Removing more than two GPG signatures from commit messages can corrupt stack memory, potentially causing denial of service during merges.
Certain fast-import features can access arbitrary paths and are now disallowed by default.
A server can advertise a malformed unborn HEAD, causing unintended file writes during subsequent ref updates with the files ref backend.
krb5: Unauthenticated KDC DoS based on ASN.1 decoder read overrun
krb5: Unauthorized key reset of protected principal via kpasswd
krb5: Improper authorization via flawed PAC checksum verification
krb5: kadmind: request alteration and protected information disclosure
krb5: Alteration of authentication indicators in CAMMAC container
krb5: Unauthenticated KDC NULL pointer dereference KDC DoS via crafted PKINIT pre-auth request
Forge: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature forgery via non-canonical DigestInfo encoding

konflux-ci: Unvalidated hostname fields enable Caddyfile config injection in the Konflux UI proxy generator, allowing an unauthenticated route to be spliced ahead of the forward_auth/impersonate authorization chain
